trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Ask about validity and express fear of disconnection.
steps.text: माझा validity कधी संपत आहे? Number बंद तर होणार ना?
steps.clean_text: माझा validity कधी संपत आहे? Number बंद तर नाही होणार ना?
steps.model_visible_text: माझा validity कधी संपत आहे? Number बंद तर होणार ना?

steps.purpose: Reassure the customer and ask to confirm the MSISDN.
steps.text: नमस्कार. घाबरू नका, तुमचा number बंद नाही होणार. मी check करतो. तुमचा number MSN-1003 आहे का?

steps.purpose: Confirm the MSISDN.
steps.text: हो, तोच number आहे.

steps.purpose: Fetch subscriber details.
Return subscriber details.
Read out the current plan, validity, balance, and data left.
steps.text: तुमचा current plan P299 आहे. तुमची validity 2 दिवसात संपणार आहे. Balance 45 rupees आहे आणि 6.5 GB data बाकी आहे.

steps.purpose: Challenge the validity days due to skepticism.
steps.text: 10 दिवस? मी मागच्या महिन्यात recharge केला होता, एवढ्या लवकर कसा संपणार? तुम्ही check केलं का बरोबर?

steps.purpose: Correct the misheard digit and reaffirm the exact validity from the tool result.
steps.text: क्षमा करा, 10 दिवस नाही, फक्त 2 दिवस बाकी आहेत. System मध्ये 2 days validity left दिसत आहे. तुमचा current plan P299 आहे.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and request a recharge.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. मग recharge करून घ्या, माझा number चालू ठेवायचा आहे.

steps.purpose: Identify missing plan ID and ask the customer before proceeding.
steps.text: नक्कीच. पण recharge करण्यापूर्वी, तुम्हाला कोणता plan हवा आहे ते सांगा. मी available plans list check करू का?

steps.purpose: Ask for benefits of the current plan before deciding.
steps.text: हो, same P299 च्या plan मध्ये काय बेनेफिट्स आहेत ते सांगा पहिले. आणि data किती असेल?

steps.purpose: Fetch available plans.
Return available plans.
Quote the exact price, validity, data, and OTT status of P299.
steps.text: P299 plan ची price 299 rupees आहे. याची validity 28 दिवस आहे आणि यात 1.5 GB data मिळतो. यात OTT included नाहीये.

steps.purpose: Challenge the data amount and ask for a plan with more data and OTT.
steps.text: फक्त 1.5 GB data? मला जास्त data हवा आहे. दुसरा कोणता plan आहे का ज्यात जास्त data मिळतो? आणि OTP पण हवा आहे.

steps.purpose: Clarify the misheard word and offer the P399 plan.
steps.text: तुम्हाला OTT हवा आहे का? P399 plan आहे. याची price 399 rupees आहे, validity 28 दिवस आहे, आणि यात 2.5 GB data मिळतो. यात OTT included आहे.

steps.purpose: Agree to the P399 plan and ask if it applies immediately.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, मग हा P399 चा recharge करा. पण हा लगेच

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the truncated question and confirm immediate application.
steps.text: हो, तुमचा number prepaid आहे, म्हणून recharge लगेच apply होईल. मी P399 चा recharge apply करतो.

steps.purpose: Apply the recharge.
Return the recharge status.
Provide the transaction ID and effective status exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: तुमचा 399 rupees चा recharge successful झाला आहे. Transaction ID TXN-9988 आहे आणि हा plan immediate effective झाला आहे.

steps.purpose: Express relief that the number won't be disconnected.
steps.text: छान. आता माझा number बंद नाही होणार. Thank you.

steps.purpose: Confirm the number remains active and offer further assistance.
steps.text: हो, तुमचा number चालू राहील. अजून काही मदत हवी आहे का?

steps.purpose: Decline further help but ask a final question about the next recharge cycle.
steps.text: नाही, एवढंच होतं. पण पुढच्या वेळी recharge कधी करायचा?

steps.purpose: State the validity of the new plan.
steps.text: तुमच्या P399 plan ची validity 28 दिवस आहे, त्यामुळे तुम्हाला 28 दिवसांनंतर recharge करावा लागेल.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. Bye.

steps.purpose: Say goodbye.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमचा दिवस शुभ असो.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
